title: Structural inability to output empty masks
note: Safety-relevant architectural failure mode: SAM cannot say 'nothing here'; cheap to demonstrate, deployment consequences for screening/detection uses.

title: Alpha/rank scale confound explains contradictory LoRA-on-SAM findings
note: Meta-science with field-level leverage: one confound reconciling a contradictory literature, plus a corrective recipe.

title: BN-based TTA silently no-ops on LayerNorm models
note: Decisive negative-result audit of methods ported without checking; falsifiable in hours.

title: Closed-region prior with fractal-boundary threshold
note: Predicts exactly which amorphous objects fail; unifies Worker A territory with Worker C's entire amorphous shard.

title: Stuff blindness as prompt-language insufficiency
note: Conceptual expressivity-boundary result: no prompt type can express 'this material everywhere'; deeper than a benchmark increment.

title: Static spatial-prior baseline may explain fixed-camera adaptation gains
note: Embarrassing-baseline attack: PEFT papers may be re-learning where things are; contrarian and cheap.

title: SAM logits secretly contain alpha mattes
note: Converges with w14p1c-041 and w14p1c-110 from an independent shard; convergence raises prior. Free-capability extraction claim.

title: Universal half-pixel boundary offset from bilinear logit upsampling
note: One-parameter correction affecting every SAM output; tiny, decisive, universally consequential if true.

title: Adapter backdoors with spectral detection defense
note: Novel threat model for the adapter-sharing ecosystem; safety value independent of benchmark performance.

title: Freezing-bug audit of 'frozen backbone' PEFT results
note: Meta-science: if unintended-parameter training explains part of reported gains, many papers are affected.

title: Decoder transplant onto a different frozen encoder
note: Promptability as a portable interface; architecturally ambitious with a clean falsification (linear bridge only).

title: Frozen-prompt-encoder convention is unjustified
note: Contrarian against a default convention that is inherited, not tested; click-semantics gap framing is sharp.

title: Confidently wrong exactly where raters disagree most
note: Clinically critical confidence inversion; failure-mode claim with direct safety implications.

title: Dose reduction degrades models before human-perceptible quality
note: Inverts an assumed safety margin in low-dose imaging; high-stakes contrarian with a controlled-physics test.

title: 8-bit conversion erases low-contrast lesions
note: Silent pipeline failure setting a hard recall ceiling invisible in aggregate metrics; broad deployment reach.

title: Isotropic resampling harmful on native anisotropic data
note: Directly contradicts standard preprocessing practice; cheap paired-inference test.

title: Burned-in overlays act as spatial anchors
note: Vivid, decisive shortcut failure (moving rulers/text moves masks); trivially demonstrable, deployment-relevant.

title: TTA improves mean Dice while increasing undetected catastrophic failures
note: Mean-vs-tail safety inversion; reframes how test-time adaptation must be evaluated in clinical settings.

title: Model-version churn exceeds rescan test-retest variation
note: Identifies churn, not accuracy, as the binding constraint for longitudinal clinical use; unusual and consequential framing.

title: Hallucinating surgically removed organs
note: Dramatic contextual-expectation failure with a clean context-ablation experimental design; cheap and decisive.

title: Federated adapter weights invert to site statistics
note: Privacy attack undermining the rationale for sharing adapters instead of data; safety/privacy value.

title: Dice ranking decouples from margin-critical clinical error
note: Attacks leaderboard validity precisely in the regime where current models operate; field-level evaluation science.

title: Medical test sets statistically underpowered for claimed deltas
note: Computable by resampling alone, no new data; potentially field-changing meta-science.

title: Expert-parity claims depend on human time budget
note: Contrarian audit of the field's headline claim; time-controlled comparison is a simple decisive design.

title: IoU head anti-informative on smoke
note: Stronger than miscalibration: the quality head ranks its own worst mask first; sharp falsifiable failure claim.

title: SAM sees through thin smoke and segments the occluded background
note: Signature amorphous-target failure mode; reframes the error as occlusion-handling, not boundary quality.

title: Refraction warp field is the key transparent-object cue and ViTs are blind to it
note: Deep representational-gap claim linking optics to architecture; testable with warp-field probes.

title: Two-axis failure taxonomy: glass fails interior, smoke fails boundary
note: Unifying framework for the shard that predicts which fix works; organizes many sibling ideas.

title: Binary masks are a category error for smoke; matting formulation wins even on binary IoU
note: Task-reformulation contrarianism; converges with w14A-091 and w14p1c-110.

title: Frozen dehazing transmission map as zero-training smoke segmenter
note: Embarrassing-baseline attack on the subfield; if competitive, resets the SOTA conversation.

title: Temporal-variance map beats zero-shot SAM on static cameras
note: The skipped trivial baseline; high audit value for the surveillance-smoke literature.

title: IoU and alarm latency nearly uncorrelated
note: The field's metric does not measure the product objective; deployment-critical metric-validity result.

title: SAM-mined failures transfer across vision foundation models
note: Turns failure mining into transferable science about shared pretraining blind spots rather than model quirks.

title: Active-learning acquisition logic inverts on amorphous targets
note: Contrarian against AL orthodoxy: labeling most-ambiguous images is harmful when ambiguity is aleatoric.

title: Weather augmentation is label poison for smoke training
note: Failure of a common practice with a precise mechanism (unlabeled positives injected into negatives); cheap A/B falsification.

title: Auto-exposure makes fires self-hiding
note: System-level failure invisible to model-centric research; alarm latency governed by camera AE policy, not the model.

title: Prompt-perturbation sensitivity as diagnostic/uncertainty signal
note: Largest convergent family (11 ideas, all 3 shards). Convergence raises the hypothesis prior AND creates the biggest dedup burden; merge to one canonical idea with domain instantiations.

title: Confidence / IoU-head miscalibration inversion family
note: 18 ideas share the core phenomenon 'confident where wrong'. Keep the sharpest per-domain variants (w14p1c-002, w14_p1b_002); merge the rest.

title: Patch/tokenization resolution floor for small and thin targets
note: Identical architectural-floor hypothesis stated independently in 3 domains; merge into one testable law with three testbeds.

title: Multimask / ambiguity-distribution collapse
note: Same 'hypothesis diversity collapses' claim from 3 angles (fine-tuning, rater multimodality, density structure); consolidate.

title: Token pruning/merging preferentially discards rare targets
note: Near-identical hypothesis in B and C; w14A-073 claims the opposite sign (pruning as beneficial regularizer) — preserve this designed disagreement as a single adversarial-pair idea.

title: Negation blindness in text-guided segmentation
note: Same failure mode in two domains; merge with dual-domain evaluation.

title: Annotation convention / rater style dominates model differences
note: Healthy convergent finding but heavily overlapping (15+ ideas); consolidator should keep the sharpest 3-5 variants (w14_p1b_112, w14p1c-068, w14p1c-072 among them).

title: Benchmark contamination / leakage family
note: Coherent meta-science family; w14_p1b_106 (lesion-vs-organ contamination asymmetry fingerprint) is the most distinctive member and should survive dedup.

title: Genre monoculture: audit/measurement studies dominate
note: Majority of the 382 ideas are diagnostics/audits ('measurable' in 85, 'audit' in 52, 'predictable' in 38); Worker B nearly 100% audit-genre. Constructive genres (new architectures, task formulations, datasets-as-artifacts, training objectives) underrepresented. Steer wave-2 generators toward constructive genres.

title: Single-model anchoring on SAM
note: Worker A is SAM by design, but C's prompt/failure ideas and B's 'foundation model' framing are also SAM-shaped (promptable, IoU head, multimask). Other lineages (DINO-style SSL, text-driven, generative/diffusion segmenters, 3D-native) appear only incidentally; portfolio ages with one model family.

title: Recurring rhetorical/generative templates
note: Surface lexical diversity is good (no pair above Jaccard 0.28), but template-level repetition is high: 'X is measurable/predictable', 'free/zero-cost signal' (24), calibration framing (67). Provide wave-2 generators the template list as a negative constraint to avoid true collapse.

title: Uncertainty/calibration theme overweight (~10% of corpus)
note: Three separate uncertainty_calibration clusters (A:6, B:12, C:8 = 26 ideas) plus the 18-idea confidence-inversion family. Cap this theme at consolidation and rebalance wave-2 quotas.

title: Remote sensing / aerial / satellite / SAR segmentation
note: Only a passing mention (w14A-095). No shard owns this territory.

title: Autonomous driving and 3D: LiDAR / point-cloud / mesh / neural-field segmentation
note: Entirely absent; large active research area with distinct failure modes.

title: Microscopy / histopathology gigapixel WSI segmentation
note: Worker B is radiology-centric (CT/MR/US); cellular and gigapixel-scale segmentation unaddressed.

title: Industrial defect / anomaly segmentation; agriculture; underwater
note: High-deployment domains with no coverage.

title: Video object segmentation science beyond SAM2 memory
note: Streaming/online segmentation, long-horizon tracking; only 3 SAM2 ideas in A plus C's domain-specific temporal cluster.

title: Instance / panoptic / open-vocabulary panoptic task-formulation science
note: Open-vocab appears only in C's smoke-confusion cluster; task-formulation research unowned.

title: Fairness and demographic bias in segmentation
note: Skin tone in dermatology, demographic shift in radiology; w14_p1b_052 touches pediatric scale only.

title: Adversarial robustness and safety certification
note: Only w14A-106/107; zero adversarial ideas in B or C despite both being safety-critical domains.

title: Amodal segmentation and occlusion reasoning
note: Only w14p1c-038 incidentally; no shard treats amodal completion as a first-class topic.

title: Annotation economics, dataset curation/pruning, human-in-the-loop pipelines
note: Touched by w14A-101/103 and w14p1c-042 but not owned; labeling-cost science is a distinct territory.

title: Inconsistent id_seed schemes across shards
note: w14A-###, w14_p1b_###, w14p1c-###. Normalize at merge; preserve originals as provenance.

title: Unverified-novelty phrasing ('never been measured', 'nobody has')
note: 20 ideas state absence-of-prior-work as fact without literature search. Consolidator must downgrade to 'not verified' and must not propagate into ideas_master.jsonl as fact.

title: Uniform evidence_status HYPOTHESIS (382/382)
note: Honest and correct, but no evidence gradient exists in this field; ranking must come from judge flags, not evidence_status.
